description: This file contains functions to generate and update leave ledger entries, including handling leave allocations, applications, encashments, and expiry processing within the ERPNext system.

methods.name: update_leave_allocation_fieldname
methods.description: Maps data from the old 'carry_forwarded_leaves' field to the new 'unused_leaves' field in Leave Allocation.

methods.name: generate_allocation_ledger_entries
methods.description: Creates ledger entries for leave allocations that are missing.

methods.name: generate_application_leave_ledger_entries
methods.description: Creates ledger entries for leave applications that are missing.

methods.name: generate_encashment_leave_ledger_entries
methods.description: Creates ledger entries for leave encashments that are missing.

methods.name: generate_expiry_allocation_ledger_entries
methods.description: Expires leave allocations that are past their 'to_date' and not yet expired.

methods.name: get_allocation_records
methods.description: Retrieves all approved leave allocation records ordered by 'to_date'.

methods.name: get_leaves_application_records
methods.description: Retrieves all approved leave application records.

methods.name: get_leave_encashment_records
methods.description: Retrieves all approved leave encashment records.
